verdict.rationale: Jitsu's self-hosting docs say it is "100% open-source", and its llms.txt calls it an open-source platform. The public GitHub repo jitsucom/jitsu is cited directly, and an HN user reports running the open-source version. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named (e.g. MIT or another OSI license), and nothing confirms that every component, including newer Kubernetes and enterprise features, is under that open license.
